text:
jordan-sales: Heads up 305 Mosaic POC procurement pushed a payment holdback redline on the OF. They want escrow language + 20% holdback until "acceptance". Can legal/proc advise?
maya-se: From the technical side we can do acceptance gates but need them explicit. Suggest: smoke test, 95th pct latency <200ms, and sample generation QA of 50 examples.
lena-legal: I prefer 'reserve payment' not 'escrow'. Escrow adds custody issues. Draft replacement: 
```
Reserve Payment: Customer may reserve up to 15% of the Order Form fees pending completion of the Acceptance Checklist. Redwood will release reserved amounts within 10 business days after mutual written acceptance. No escrow account or third-party holdback required.
```
dan-proc: Finance will approve 15% if release tied to measurable milestones. Also need a signer map: customer PO + Procurement Head, Redwood AE + Finance Ops. Can we do one DocuSign envelope for all four?
jordan-sales: Yes, customer asked for single envelope. On our side it's Jordan (AE) and finance-ops@redwood. @lena-legal ok to proceed with that clause?
lena-legal: OK with 15% clause. Recommend fallback if acceptance aren't agreed: release 30 days after production traffic or a dispute resolution step. I'll add short fallback line.
maya-se: Please include the acceptance checklist as an attachment in the envelope. I will upload the one-pager with test owners and exact metrics.
ops-bot: Draft envelope created: env_mosaic_5821 (status: draft). Tagged: lena-legal for final review.
dan-proc: I'll add customer signers once we have emails. Also confirm Bill terms: net30 vs net45? Procurement prefers Net45 for larger customers.
jordan-sales: Mosaic agreed to Net30 in commercials but we can accept Net45 if finance approves. @finance-ops any blockers?
ops-bot: finance-ops@redwood: No blocker provided in channel, please @finance-ops directly for approval.
lena-legal: Final suggested language pasted in OF before DocuSign. If customer insists on escrow, we should propose limited holdback + acceptance checklist instead.
jordan-sales: Plan: lena to insert clause, maya to attach checklist, dan to finalize envelope and add signers, I'll confirm customer signer emails. Target: send by COB tomorrow. :thumbsup:
dan-proc: Roger. Will prepare envelope and route to legal before sending externally.
maya-se: Uploaded acceptance checklist to ticket. includes: 1) smoke test pass, 2) 95th pct latency <200ms over 24h, 3) 50 sample output QA >= 85% pass rate.
lena-legal: Noted. If Mosaic pushes for 20% we can counter with 15% + explicit acceptance metrics. Ready to sign once envelope is updated.
jordan-sales: Thanks all. I'll update SFDC after envelope sent.
